{{Nihongo|'''''Dashi'''''|[[wikt:出|出]][[wikt:汁|汁]], だし}} is a family of [[stock (food)|stock]]s used in [[Japanese cuisine]]. ''Dashi'' forms the base for [[miso soup]], clear broth soup, noodle broth soup, and many simmering liquids to accentuate the savory flavor known as [[umami]].<ref>{{cite news|title=Umami – The Delicious 5th Taste You Need to Master!|url=http://www.molecularrecipes.com/molecular-gastronomy/umami/|work=Molecular Recipes|date=24 March 2013}}</ref> ''Dashi'' is also mixed into the flour base of some grilled foods like [[okonomiyaki]] and [[takoyaki]].
